front.title: Multicast and Ethernet VPN with Segment Routing Point-to-Multipoint (P2MP) and Ingress Replication

abstract.t: A Point-to-Multipoint (P2MP) tree in a Segment Routing (SR) domain carries traffic from a Root to a set of Leaves. This document specifies extensions to BGP encodings and procedures for P2MP trees and Ingress Replication used in BGP/MPLS IP VPNs and Ethernet VPNs (EVPNs) in an SR domain. This document updates RFCs 6514 and 7988.
